about_the_game:
BLACKSUITE is a cinematic third-person multiplayer shooter that plays like an epic, non-stop action movie. Stylish stunts, 360° aiming, and raw close-quarters gunfights combine to create the ultimate high-octane firefight.

In BLACKSUITE, style means lethality. The better you master the free-flowing stunt system and 360 degree precision aiming, the more unstoppable you become.

Enter Bullet Time

Every kill charges your Focus-meter, granting you precious seconds of bullet time you can trigger at will. When activated, time slows for everyone nearby—except you. With a slight speed advantage, you can dodge bullets and execute stylish stunts. Focus is a tactical tool that transforms close-quarters shootouts into intense, cinematic firefights.

Style is Power

In BLACKSUITE, Style Level is earned through execution. Take down enemies while diving, sliding, and cartwheeling through combat to build momentum. Higher Style Levels increase your lethality and unlock bullet-time moments. Fight with style — and you control the battlefield.

Advanced Movement System

Dive through windows, slide under gunfire, cartwheel across hallways, or roll into cover — all while firing in any direction with full 360° aiming. Every move has purpose: dodge bullets, break line of sight, or reposition mid-fight without ever losing momentum. Mastering stunts and adapting them to the fight is how you gain the upper hand.

Run the Case - Signature Mode

Run the Case is BLACKSUITE's signature multiplayer signature —a high-stakes, cinematic showdown where two rival corporations battle to snatch a central briefcase and rush it to dynamically changing delivery zones before the enemy does.

The briefcase drops right in the middle of the map. Grab it, hold it, steal it back in a brutal firefight, or hurl it to a teammate mid-dive. You must deliver the briefcase within strict time limit for maximum payoff for your team.

Delivery points shift unpredictably each round, forcing constant adaptation. First team to rack up the most successful deliveries wins the match. Every second counts—move fast and protect carrier.

The match evolves without warning. Mid-match events can shift routes and objectives, demanding fast adaptation and decisive action.

Cinematic Gunfights

BLACKSUITE is built from the ground up to look and feel like an action movie — down to the smallest detail. Bullets leave visible trails, explosions kick up debris, and shell casings spin in the air.

Dynamic camera angles highlight stylish kills and final shots, turning your best plays into cinematic highlights. Every firefight feels like a choreographed scene of chaos and impact.

Instant Cinematic Action

BLACKSUITE gets you into the fight faster than you can chamber-check your Glock. No waiting. No fluff. No cat skins. No massive updates for cosmetics you’ll never use. No 20-minute shader compilations.

Just pure, authentic, stylish action.

content_descriptors.notes: You will send your enemies flying through windows with shotguns; they will bleed and stumble down realistically. When you get hit, you can feel the impact in your bones. BLACKSUITE is not for the faint-hearted.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows® 10
  • Processor: 4 hardware CPU threads - Intel® Core™ i5 750 or higher
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Video card must be 1 GB or more and should be a DirectX 11-compatible with support for Shader Model 5.0
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • VR Support: No VR support
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows® 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5 (6-core, 12-thread) or equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® RTX™ 3050 or equivalent (DirectX 12 compatible)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • VR Support: No VR support

short_description: Suit up as an elite agent in a cinematic, 3rd-person, bullet-time multiplayer shooter where two rival corporations wage a brutal war of hired killers. Master advanced movement like dives, slides, and cartwheels with full 360° aiming — and send your enemies flying through skyscraper windows.
